tasks.summary_en: Draw an 8-digit number from digits $\{0,1,3,5,7,9\}$: P(digit sum=3)
tasks.statement_en: From the set of all eight-digit natural numbers whose decimal digits all come from the set $\{0,1,3,5,7,9\}$, we draw one number. Find the probability of the event that the sum of the digits of the drawn number equals 3.

tasks.statement_en: Given is an increasing geometric sequence $(a, aq, aq^2)$, whose terms and common ratio are all odd integers. If the largest term of the sequence is decreased by 4, an arithmetic sequence is obtained. Compute the term aq of this sequence.

Given is an infinite sequence of circles $(o_n)$ with equations $x^2+y^2=2^{11-n}$, $n\ge1$. Let $P_k$ be the ring (annulus) bounded by the outer circle $o_{2k-1}$ and the inner circle $o_{2k}$. Compute the sum of the areas of all rings $P_k$, where $k\ge1$.

tasks.statement_en: A right trapezoid ABCD with bases AB and CD is circumscribed on a circle. The leg BC has length 10, and the leg AD is the height of the trapezoid. The base AB is twice as long as the base CD. Compute the area of this trapezoid.

tasks.statement_en: The vertices A and B of a right triangle ABC lie on the y-axis of the coordinate system. The circle inscribed in this triangle is tangent to sides AB, BC and CA at the points $P=(0,10)$, $Q=(8,6)$ and $R=(9,13)$, respectively. Compute the coordinates of the vertices A, B and C of this triangle.

tasks.summary_en: Wooden frame $V(x)$: find x and $V_{max}$ (sum) (part c)
tasks.statement_en: We consider all possible wooden frames of the shape shown in the figure, built from slats. Each slat has the shape of a rectangular cuboid with a square base of side length x. The frame's dimensions are marked in the figure. [Figure: a rectangular box-shaped wooden frame (skeleton) built from square-cross-section slats, with edge dimensions 6, 6, and 10 marked] a) Express the volume V of wood needed to build the frame as a function of the variable x. b) Determine the domain of the function V. c) Compute the value of x for which the constructed frame is heaviest, i.e. for which the function V attains its greatest value. Compute this greatest volume.
tasks.notes: Only part c) is numeric (parts a: formula, b: domain interval, are excluded); value is x + V_max from part c. [verified: ok: V=8(11x^2-3x^3) on (0,5/2], max at x=22/9, V=42592/243 (key p.20); only part c numeric, x+V=43186/243.]
